g_policy.reason: The offer copy states the reward (10× memory for the next 5 replies) before the game and the user opts in. Declining leaves the sheet unchanged, and `if the ad fails` covers a missing game or an unconfirmed play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is a temporary context boost for 5 replies, which has no cash value and cannot be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is an app event: a subscriber opens the chat history sheet (s18) on a character with a saved chat. No chat text is needed.

g_no_free_removal.reason: `removes nothing free` is yes and nothing free is capped or locked. The proposal adds an optional boost and leaves the existing 5× memory as it is.

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits inside the chat history sheet (s18), which is over My Chats (s03) and both are rated safe. It is not in the message list and not over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor proposal. The app charges for context via the Plus bullet '5× context for better memory' (s16.e09, l4), so the reward gives a resource the app charges for.

c2_evidence.reason: The claims about the paywall, the 5× bullet, the price, and the 15 message count (s18.e13) and 15 chats (s03.e12) are supported by the cited elements. The 'no add-on or ads seen' claim is worded as not seen. The 8k-token cost and 'replies' details describe the new offer or are labeled assumptions.

c3_spares_payers.reason: The offer is shown only to paying Janitor Plus users and is pitched as more of what their plan sells: 10× memory, 'double your Janitor Plus 5×'. That matches the fail condition where paying users see the offer and it is more of their plan's benefit.

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The boost covers 5 replies in one chat and expires at midnight, with a cap of 1 per day. It is a sample that ends and takes nothing from other users or creators.

c5_moment.reason: The user opens the chat history sheet and sees the card there, so it does not interrupt a task in progress. It is offered on a sheet the user chose to open.

c6_fits_simula.reason: This is a play-to-earn sponsored game. The boost is granted only after the play is confirmed, and the trigger (opening s18 as a subscriber) is an event the app can detect.

c7_specific.reason: It names the Plus '5× context' bullet, the s18 chat history sheet, and the Start new chat button, so it would not read the same in any app.

other_concern: The offer to subscribers who already pay for memory is the core problem. A sample for free users would be a different idea. Whether 10× context is technically possible and what it costs to serve is an unobserved assumption, and the model lists the free limit as an open question.
